landing.heroDescription: More than language course. Master German while learning to navigate real life in Germany — from bureaucracy to Brezeln.
landing.whyTitle: Not just language. A complete guide to German life
landing.whyDescription: We bridge the gap between knowing the words and living the life. Every lesson brings you closer to feeling at home.
landing.structuredCurriculumDesc: From A1 to C1, our courses follow a clear path designed by native German linguists and certified teachers.
landing.culturalIntegrationDesc: Learn how to navigate Anmeldung, health insurance, taxes, and everyday German life alongside your language studies.
landing.realLifeScenariosDesc: Practice with real dialogues - at the Auslanderamt, the doctor's office, your workplace, and the local Bäckerei.
landing.communityLearningDesc: Connect with fellow learners, join conversation groups, and build friendships that accelerate your integration.
landing.propositionTitle: Learn the language of everyday life
landing.propositionDescription: Our courses don't stop at grammar and vocabulary. We teach you how to order at a Kneipe, what to say at the Bürgeramt, how German humor works, and why you should never be late.
landing.propositionItem4: Understanding the Pfand system and recycling culture
landing.trackDescription: Watch your German skills grow lesson by lesson. Our learning dashboard keeps you motivated with clear progress tracking, streaks, and milestone celebrations.
landing.review1Quote: I moved to Munich not speaking a word. Six months with büro.de and I handled my entire Anmeldung process in German. The cultural lessons were a game-changer.
landing.review2Quote: Other platforms teach you textbook German. büro.de teaches you how Germans actually talk. I finally understand my colleagues' jokes.
landing.review3Quote: The bureaucracy modules alone are worth it. I knew exactly what documents to bring to the Ausländerbehörde. No stress, no surprises.
landing.ctaDescription: Join thousands of expats who chose to truly integrate. Start with a free trial lesson today — no credit card required.
